title: all-hands
text:
all-hands

elaine: Thanks everyone for joining today — great turnout. Quick thread to capture clarifications from the Q&A, links, and concrete owners. I’ll nudge owners after this thread.

ops-bot: Recording uploaded: https://redwood.cloud/ah/1745678901/recording · Slides: https://drive.redwood/teams/all-hands/1745678901/slides :white_check_mark:

maria: pinned the recording + deck in #all-hands and added a one-page TL;DR to the drive (link above).

raj: Re: Dedicated GA question — goal is an "early Q3" GA but we’ll ship as a phased canary (tiered customers first). I’m owning the rollout plan and will post a schedule. Target: finalize plan by 2024-05-10.

kai: Observability retention and pricing: we heard the ask for longer traces and token-level cost breakdown retention. I’ll draft retention tiers + pricing/rate limits and an ops playbook. Owner: kai. ETA: 2024-05-03.

sam: On-prem / private pilot: we’ll run a small pilot with two customers in June to validate install, KMS integration, and support runbook. Owner: sam. I’ll open a project board and list required engineers. Target board ready by 2024-06-01.

devex: SDK compatibility question — we will keep major-semver guarantees. Deprecation schedule and migration notes incoming. Owner: devex. ETA: 2024-04-28.

elaine: SLA question for Dedicated — sales + account teams to follow up with customers who asked. Raj, please hand off the rollout milestones so GTM can build comms.

maria: Compact action list I added to the follow-up doc:
```
- Raj: finalize Dedicated GA plan + public timeline (due 2024-05-10)
- Kai: observability retention & pricing doc (due 2024-05-03)
- Sam: on-prem pilot project board + initial roster (due 2024-06-01)
- Devex: SDK deprecation/migration schedule (due 2024-04-28)
- Maria: publish TL;DR and pin assets (done)
```

raj: Ack — I’ll post the rollout doc + canary criteria by EOD tomorrow and tag product + sales.

kai: Ack, creating the retention folder and will link the doc here when ready.

sam: Opening PRD and inviting infra + security engs to the board today.

elaine: If anyone had a question in the live Q&A that wasn’t answered, reply here and we’ll queue it for leadership to respond. Thanks all — appreciate the fast follow-up. :heart:
